title: DublinCorePeriodOfTime
description:
Interface for Dublin Core Terms Period of Time.
An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end dates.

dcat:startDate.description: The start date of the period.

dcat:endDate.description: The end date of the period.

time:hasBeginning.description: The beginning of a period or interval.

time:hasEnd.description: The end of a period or interval.
